accepted_rules: Exact retained domain text and verified raw Git bytes remain domain content.
A generic JSON response replica cannot replace mandatory HTTP originals.
Missing, explicit null, empty and unchanged are distinct.
Actual parser module/version is per-value provenance, never current-selection authority.
Typed identities, parents and owners remain; names and URLs do not merge them.
Comparable provider clocks can order values; receipt, parse time, parser version and UUIDs cannot.
New domain-field inventory, lifecycles, selection, publication and retention choices require owner approval.

analysis_baseline.scope: Production composed DDL, production writers/readers/public projections and surviving contracts; synthetic data only

alternatives.meaning: Retain the named identities, content, state, relationships, code targets/patch availability, event variants and inventory properties; use typed tables/columns and closed domain JSON where useful. Unknown response keys are not durable originals.
alternatives.name: Typed broad domain contract

alternatives.meaning: Retain accepted invariant fields and exactly the reviewed current feature subset; explicitly retire unselected public metadata/patch/event/inventory attributes. Additional named domain fields require a future contract extension and new acquisition.
alternatives.name: Typed functional minimum

alternatives.meaning: Retain invariant fields in typed relational structures and selected provider-specific closed extension schemas with versioned meanings. No arbitrary unknown-key carrier; every extension has presence/evidence/consumer rules.
alternatives.name: Typed core plus named extensions

decision.blocks: Whole-provider projection removal and final historical/current domain schema; does not block inventory tooling or accepted missing/null correctness fixes.
dependencies: Q01/Q02/Q03 determine retained historical families, not the meanings of field values
Q04/Q05 determine observation and membership/publication evidence references
Q10 derives Exchange portable field validation from the approved contract
examples: File row filename=a.py with absent patch differs from patch=null and patch=''; A retains exact patch/availability, B must explicitly omit patch from the product contract, C uses a closed diff extension.
Issue labels omitted keeps prior membership and attribution; labels=[] asserts known empty; labels=null is explicit provider null and does not establish complete empty membership.
Thread comments nodes [501], hasNextPage=true does not prove the full child roster; removing pageInfo requires normalized child terminal evidence, not treating node existence as complete.
A timeline renamed event with rename.from=before and rename.to=after has real domain meaning even when the only reader prints its payload.
Source S1 and S2 observe Repository R's permissions under different principals; neither observation becomes receiver-local authentication or rewrites R's identity.
not_feasible: Copy all old payload/metadata JSON into generic domain_payload
Delete fields solely because only public output or Exchange currently consumes them
Use receipts/parser versions to decide domain current state
decision.question: Approve the retained domain field groups F01–F19 and explicit unsupported-field behavior for F20, or select a narrower fully enumerated contract?

field_groups.class: domain identity / locator
field_groups.meaning: Provider PR database identity, provider GraphQL locator and binding-scoped human request number.
field_groups.recommendation: Retain canonical database resource ID and scoped number with typed service/binding ownership. Retain node ID only as an explicitly modeled alternate provider locator, never a substitute for database identity.
field_groups.status: Existing identities accepted; extra persistent node locator and physical columns proposed

field_groups.baseline_caveat: Historical ensure_pr maps omitted or null body to empty document text; PR payload still distinguishes them. Replacing payload without a presence contract would lose that distinction.
field_groups.class: domain content
field_groups.meaning: Exact PR title and body; documents use accepted natural identity with provider PR ID.
field_groups.recommendation: Retain exact UTF-8 title/body with explicit missing/null/present states and truthful observation evidence. Avoid copying them into a second raw provider replica.
field_groups.status: Exact content and natural document key accepted; historical lifecycle and presence layout proposed

field_groups.class: domain attribute
field_groups.meaning: Observed workflow state, locking and merge readiness; mergeability may be explicitly null while provider calculation is pending.
field_groups.recommendation: Retain workflow/lock/draft state and explicitly nullable merge-readiness attributes. Normalize actual instants to _us; no mergeability field becomes a trusted ordering clock.
field_groups.status: Proposed retained inventory; ordering restrictions accepted

field_groups.baseline_caveat: Current live parser retains author login only. Historical document metadata excludes user/author and retains typed login; parent PR payload retains full actor. Before the Phase 2 corrective implementation, a present author object with omitted login incorrectly projects author:null.
field_groups.class: domain identity / relationship / display attribute
field_groups.meaning: Authorship and workflow actors; service-scoped provider user/team ID is distinct from mutable login/name.
field_groups.recommendation: Retain modeled actor resource identity, observed login/type, nullable author attribution, and ordered/unordered assignment/reviewer memberships according to their semantics. Do not retain actor avatar/API URL bundles as an unmodeled subtree.
field_groups.status: Existing author value/provenance accepted; actor identity expansion and memberships proposed

field_groups.class: domain code identity / relationship; duplicated snapshot subtrees
field_groups.meaning: Observed PR code target and source/base repository references; deleted forks can yield null repository context.
field_groups.recommendation: Retain explicit object format/OIDs, observed source/base ref names and service-scoped provider repository references with null state. Never merge a nested fork by URL/name or assert local Repository registration merely because a provider nested object exists.
field_groups.status: Verified Git OIDs/typed owners accepted; nested reference field inventory proposed

field_groups.class: domain attributes / relationships / provider completeness corroboration
field_groups.meaning: Labels/milestone, provider instants, count estimates, diff statistics and reaction summary; counts do not prove enumeration completeness.
field_groups.producer: ensure_pr entire object; ApiFacts.document all remaining keys; current_parser.issue selected metadata
field_groups.recommendation: Retain typed label/milestone identity and observed descriptive fields; normalized instants; integer counts/statistics and explicitly modeled reaction types. Keep count observation separate from terminal/member proof and label-set completeness separate from Issue existence.
field_groups.status: Proposed retained inventory; counts-cannot-prove-complete accepted

field_groups.baseline_caveat: Conversation comment null or omitted body currently becomes empty text and is removed from metadata, so the core document alone cannot distinguish them. This is an existing information-loss boundary, not permission to preserve it in the new schema.
field_groups.class: mixed domain content / capture relationship / transport locators
field_groups.meaning: PR conversation comment content and individual observation attributes. PR title/body documents currently carry almost the entire PR detail metadata too.
field_groups.recommendation: Retain exact text and observed author/login, domain web URL, created/updated instants, associations/reactions and typed PR parent. API collection URL is acquisition context, not an immutable comment property; eliminate duplicate PR detail snapshots from title/body metadata.
field_groups.status: Text/parents accepted; comment history/current policy and exact field subset proposed

field_groups.class: domain event union plus unmodeled response replica
field_groups.meaning: Heterogeneous GitHub timeline events including identity-less variants, content-bearing comments/reviews/commits and typed transition relationships.
field_groups.recommendation: Define an explicit tagged domain event union with common kind/nullable native event ID/actor/time and type-specific label, milestone, assignment, rename, review-dismissal, cross-reference and commit/document targets. Content-bearing event variants require exact domain text. Unknown kinds produce an explicit unavailable-field/unsupported-kind observation; no generic original JSON fallback.
field_groups.status: Proposed union and unsupported-kind policy; no event kind is declared disposable merely because only public output reads it

field_groups.class: domain state / child-membership evidence / transport continuation
field_groups.meaning: Independent thread state, child comment roster and nested boundary evidence. End cursor is an operational continuation locator.
field_groups.producer: GitHubCollector._thread strips comment content to ID nodes and preserves thread keys
field_groups.recommendation: Retain thread identity, resolved/outdated assertions and child membership/completeness under a chosen domain publication contract. Retain comment content in current review_resources. Move provider cursor to the chosen operational checkpoint/cache; no child content is implied complete by thread existence.
field_groups.status: Identity/current comment relationships accepted; historical thread state and collection proof pending

field_groups.class: domain code identity / membership / provider metadata / API locators
field_groups.meaning: PR commit-list membership and provider commit attributes; provider signatures/actor mappings are observations distinct from verified Git raw bytes.
field_groups.recommendation: Retain typed OID and list position, parent/tree references, exact provider message if independently meaningful, actor mapping and explicit provider verification assertion. Raw Git commit integrity is separate and cannot be inferred from provider verification JSON. API URLs are not required bytes.
field_groups.status: OID integrity accepted; provider commit metadata inventory/lifecycle proposed

field_groups.class: domain path / relationship / content / availability / locators
field_groups.meaning: Changed-file membership, rename relationship, diff statistics and provider patch text; patch omission/truncation is not an empty diff.
field_groups.producer: GitHubCollector.sync_pr nested file_item; filename UTF-8 bytes and whole object
field_groups.recommendation: Retain exact current/previous path bytes, status, optional blob OID, counts and exact optional patch with availability state. Do not promise provider patch is complete; recomputation from Git is a separately attributed derived value. Domain web locators may be explicitly modeled; API/raw download URLs never trigger automatic fetching.
field_groups.status: Exact paths/content restrictions accepted; patch retention and availability contract proposed

field_groups.class: domain identity / attributes / relationships / principal-scoped observation / transport locators
field_groups.meaning: Source-owned inventory view of repository identity, attributes, discovery endpoints and scope-local permissions. Nested parent/source repositories must not merge identity by name/URL.
field_groups.recommendation: Retain provider ID, observed names/owner, endpoint observations, visibility/archived/fork/default branch/descriptive attributes, typed parent/source provider references and explicitly principal-scoped permissions when authorized. Counts and provider capabilities remain observations with known meaning. Source publication owns these rows even though Repository is their subject.
field_groups.status: Independent Source/service/Repository identity accepted; Source history, attributes and permissions inventory proposed

field_groups.class: domain workflow / relationships / statistics; provider-shaped nested values
field_groups.meaning: All ten known live ordinary-Issue metadata keys; unknown nested keys inside labels/assignees/milestone/reactions remain opaque today.
field_groups.recommendation: Keep each domain meaning but type the inner label/actor/milestone/reaction contract and instants. Preserve absent/null/empty sets and per-path provenance. Comments count is not a complete comment roster.
field_groups.status: Current lifecycle and field evidence accepted; normalized inventory proposed

field_groups.class: domain attributes
field_groups.meaning: Ordinary Issue-comment creation instant and reaction summary; PR conversation comments use F07 instead.
field_groups.recommendation: Retain typed created_at_us and reaction summary with per-field presence/provenance. Do not transfer ordinary-Issue latest-state policy to PR conversation comments.
field_groups.status: Current lifecycle and identity accepted; typed metadata proposed

field_groups.class: domain content / state / target; alternate locator and API navigation
field_groups.meaning: All current live review fields; submitted_at is not an update clock; _links is API navigation rather than review content.
field_groups.recommendation: Retain existing typed review fields and exact text/body status; explicitly decide node locator; replace _links with selected domain web URLs if needed. Never promote submitted_at or an unknown updated_at extension to ordering authority.
field_groups.status: Current lifecycle/body/clock rules accepted; metadata node/link subset pending

field_groups.class: domain content / position / typed relationships
field_groups.meaning: REST/GraphQL current review-comment location, range, stable targets and typed review/reply/thread parents; original versus current position is meaningful.
field_groups.producer: current_parser.review_comment; GraphQL query resources define narrower root/child selection
field_groups.recommendation: Retain every current location/range/target/parent field with nullable/present distinction. Normalize creation instant; retain diff hunk exactly; keep provider text path separate from raw Git path bytes. Missing start-side/range fields do not acquire another field's evidence.
field_groups.status: Stable targets/typed parents/current lifecycle accepted; typed metadata layout pending

field_groups.class: domain provenance / receiver-local check boundary
field_groups.meaning: Authored capture ownership, endpoint/principal/API-version scope and per-retained-path observation/provider-clock/parser attribution; not a saved response.
field_groups.recommendation: Retain domain capture facts and actual per-field module/version/clock/time. Captured owner identifiers may be detached snapshots; last_checked_at_us remains receiver-local and is excluded from exchange. No mandatory message/profile reference.
field_groups.status: Already authorized; layout implementation-dependent

field_groups.baseline_caveat: GitParsing.commit uses a dict of first physical header lines excluding tree/parent, so duplicate nonstructural keys and folded continuations are absent from metadata; raw_headers/object bytes are intact. QueryService retrieves decoding settings through parser_profiles today.
field_groups.class: domain content / derived interpretation
field_groups.meaning: Git domain bytes and decoded interpretations; ordered/folded/duplicate headers are preserved by raw bytes, not fully by current metadata object.
field_groups.recommendation: Retain verified raw object bytes and exact paths/refs. Retain decoder name/version and actual encoding/error policy needed by existing decoded text/byte-offset semantics; retire definition/certificate/profile authority. Choose canonical versus multiple Git interpretations separately.
field_groups.status: Raw bytes/integrity accepted; decoded interpretation/selection pending Q08

field_groups.class: domain completeness / code-target evidence
field_groups.meaning: Authored code assessment of exact observed target set, independent listing completion and matching verified acquisitions; merge preserves explicit nulls.
field_groups.recommendation: Replace asserted booleans with references to normalized checked listing/target/head-base evidence; retain the resulting assessment and missing target reasons. Provider caps are completeness limits, not number-of-member identities.
field_groups.status: Completeness correctness accepted; normalized physical evidence pending

field_groups.class: Unreviewed: may be genuine domain property, transport-only locator, or new provider extension
field_groups.meaning: Existing producer contract keeps arbitrary keys; actual semantics cannot be inferred from absence of a specialized reader.
field_groups.producer: Whole-object or residual-object producers; current projection metadata nested objects; Exchange opaque provider admission
provider_paths: unknown keys and unknown nested keys not explicitly listed above
field_groups.recommendation: Do not bulk delete unknown keys or carry them as a new generic response JSON column. Before production replacement approve a closed domain contract or explicitly named typed extension schemas. Unsupported/unknown fields become explicit capture capability gaps where they affect promised completeness; no speculative retrospective extraction.
field_groups.status: Pending Q09; inventory is exhaustive over columns/coherent key groups, not an invented exhaustive GitHub vocabulary

limitations: Static SQL call sites are syntactic candidates; dynamic table names and indirect consumers require the prose investigation.
Public projection keys include nested literal dictionaries and exclude dynamic keys; they are not a new public schema.
Provider projection columns accept unknown keys, so no finite provider-key vocabulary can be inferred from the DDL.
This is in-memory schema/AST verification, not application acceptance or a historical test receipt.

json_without_check.meaning: Operational string or authored JSON resume continuation containing cursor, thread/child IDs, merge/code information or occurrence IDs; no JSON CHECK; physical/lifetime policy pending Q06.
Accepted historical original API JSON bytes; not a provider field contract; remove only after publication/completeness/restart/304 dependencies migrate.
SQL-generated exact sealed fact membership; generated from typed natural/portable keys.
Portable remapping and integrity envelope; opaque provider fields are not recursively interpreted as catalog refs.
Presentation/pagination output with bounded nested arrays and dynamic fields; current opaque field output is a public consumer.
External disposable HTTP record; does not define core domain retention.

proposed_presence_contract.absent_from_candidate: No asserted new value; retain any prior value with its original evidence.
proposed_presence_contract.present_empty: Exact empty string/list/object; distinct from null and omission.
proposed_presence_contract.present_null: Explicit provider null; retain known null and its evidence.
proposed_presence_contract.present_unchanged: Value equality does not remove its original provenance; genuine new confirming evidence must be attributed truthfully.
proposed_presence_contract.status: Implementation-dependent encoding of accepted distinctness; exact retained fields pending Q09
proposed_presence_contract.times: Explicit domain instant columns use signed int64 Unix microseconds and _us suffixes; unknown remains NULL. Current provider-shaped timestamps are transitional replicas, not the proposed final clock representation.
proposed_presence_contract.unknown_current_scalar: SQL NULL without a corresponding present-value evidence path is unknown, not an explicit provider-null assertion.
proposed_presence_contract.unordered_conflict: Retain competing assertions and suppress an undisputed current value until justified resolution.

status: Proposed / Pending Owner Decision; no production field-retention policy is selected
